name: jev-compact
description: Before LimitSwitcher swaps a Claude Code session to another account, shrinks the tool outputs it no longer needs with TypeSafe's Jev (through OpenRouter), so the new account loads less. Everything else stays verbatim; no Claude usage.

envFile.title: LimitSwitcher .env file
envFile.description: A file with an OPENROUTER_API_KEY=... line (set when LimitSwitcher installs this mod). The OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable, or Claude Code's settings.json env block, also works.
